text: When agents drift, operations break. More tools do not fix unclear ownership, permissions, handoffs, budgets, or stop rules. The failure is often the operating layer around the models. Cross-Agent Operating Kit gives a multi-AI stack one shared control system: a master policy, agent adapters, conflict checks, a Human Gate Matrix, budget and quota guards, and a migration score. Personal is sixty-nine dollars. Fix the operating layer before adding another agent.
